_README: Q295 fat and voids audit (scripts/anatomy/q295/): per page and region, the area inside the skin that no structure covers (void), before (the Q293 pages) and after (with the Q295 fat / unlabelled-soft-tissue meshes); what the body's own imaging shows in the voids; the shipped meshes (volume, triangles, mesh defects, mean dihedral vs CVH references); fat penetration into other structures (share of the fat's section area that another non-fat structure also covers).

method.regions: head, neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis, thigh, knee, leg, foot, upper arm, forearm, hand (by the page's own bone landmarks)
method.fill: nonzero winding per structure; open meshes outline + fill-holes; sheets (fascia, joint, bursa, insertion) outline only; hidden-by-default structures not counted
